action_items.detail: planner-team-suggest-accept-mobile failed once and passed on rerun. On the failing run, Sofia's Team tab showed 'No sessions' for Nov 16-22 and the member filter was missing, but GET /api/planner/team returned 6 sessions and 5 members for the same week. This looks like a client-side race: the 'mine' and 'team' fetches can resolve in the wrong order after switching tabs. Please check that a stale response can't overwrite the team data.

Q-15 timezone was checked in the browser's default (UTC) timezone only: a 10:00 local session reloads at 10:00 AM. Reject, cancel and 409-on-pending were checked via the API, not the UI. Real Google sign-in is still human-only.
